title: HIV viral load and CD4
what: This blood test is for people living with HIV. It shows how much virus is in the blood and how many protective immune cells you have.
why: To plan how to start treatment and to check regularly that it is working.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in a few days
tell_doctor: If you were recently ill, had a fever, or had a vaccine. This can change the result for a while
What other medicines and supplements you take

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: You usually do not need to fast strictly, but it is better to come 3 to 4 hours after a light, non-fatty meal. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Treatment
prepare.text: Take your pills as usual, at your usual time. Do not skip them before the test.

prepare.title: How you feel
prepare.text: If you have a cold or fever now, tell your doctor. It may be better to move the test.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A sleeve you can easily roll up above the elbow.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
A list of all your medicines
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
Keep taking your treatment without breaks
Your result is confidential. Only you or your doctor will get it.
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red
A high fever for several days, severe shortness of breath, or confusion: see a doctor urgently or call emergency services

faq.a: It means the treatment is working. When the virus stays undetectable, HIV is not passed on through sex. Treatment still continues.

faq.q: Why does CD4 change from test to test?
faq.a: It depends on how you feel, the time of day, and even the lab. The doctor looks at the trend over several tests.

reminders.text: Viral load and CD4 test tomorrow. Take your pills as usual, without missing any.
